Jump into Jumpi Games, a free 3D virtual world made for kids!

Create your own Jumpi character, pick colors, eyes, hair and outfits, and explore a huge colorful city with your friends. Walk through the Plaza, visit the beach, the water park, the park, the school, the airport and many more places, then hop on a motorcycle and ride around town.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Make your own 3D character and dress it up with tons of clothes, hats and accessories
• Explore a big open city with 16 different areas
• Ride motorcycles and scooters (park them before they get towed!)
• Decorate your own home
• Play mini-games, spin the lucky wheel and collect coins and rare items
• Make friends and trade items

MADE FOR KIDS, SAFE BY DESIGN
• Chat is filtered, and private messages are only between friends
• A moderation team keeps the community kind
• No ads, and no paid store inside the game
